notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Here's what’s new in Update 2.0:


Visual Enhancements: Textures, lighting, and effects have been upgraded to create a more immersive world.

Improved Camera System: Enjoy smoother transitions, better angles, and more intuitive camera behavior.

Performance Boost: Reduced load times and optimized engine performance for a faster and more stable experience.

Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed a bunch of annoying bugs to improve stability and gameplay. Sorry speedruners!

Music Control: Take control of your soundtrack – improved volume options.

UI Overhaul: Cleaner, more intuitive interface with improved feedback and accessibility.


Thanks for playing – and stay tuned, more is on the way!
